title: Wedding Newspaper Template: 4 Editable A4 Pages, PPTX with Photo Placeholders and Guest Activities
description:
Create a wedding newspaper that tells your story and helps guests enjoy your day. I designed this four-page A4 layout with classic newspaper typography, space for your own photographs and a simple structure to personalise.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
One ZIP with three files:
• Editable PPTX: four portrait A4 pages
• Sample PDF: the same four pages, with placeholders
• Editing, printing and personal-use instructions

THE FOUR PAGES
1. Front cover: names, date, venue, welcome message and photo space.
2. Our Story: memories, timeline, favourite things and two photo spaces.
3. The Big Day: example schedule, wedding party and useful details.
4. Just for Fun: five editable couple-quiz questions, advice lines and photo prompts.

EDITING
Open the PPTX in a compatible editor. No Canva account or Canva template link is included or required. All text is editable in separate boxes, sometimes one line per box; longer wording may require manual adjustments. Insert and crop your own photographs over the grey shapes, then remove the placeholder text/shapes. The photo areas are not automatic drag-and-drop frames.

The PPTX uses Times New Roman and Arial. If your editor substitutes fonts, review every page carefully. Layout can vary between applications. I have checked the file structure and rendered layout; I do not claim testing in every editing application or printer.

PRINTING
A4 portrait, 210 × 297 mm. Replace all placeholders and sample times before exporting your personalised PPTX as PDF. Print one proof at 100% / Actual Size. Four separate pages are supplied, not an imposed A3 folded booklet. Duplex settings depend on your printer. No bleed or crop marks are included. The sample PDF is not a fillable form and still contains placeholders.

DOWNLOAD
Download the Etsy delivery PDF, open its Google Drive link, then download and unzip the template. Use Etsy in a web browser to access your downloads.

PLEASE NOTE
Digital files only. No photographs, printed newspapers, ribbons, flowers, tableware or other props are included. Styled promotional mockups illustrate possible use; an exact page overview is included in image 2. Your downloaded files have no advertising watermarks. English sample text is provided for you to replace. This is a self-editing template, not a personalisation service.

PERSONAL USE
Use for one wedding/private celebration and print copies for your guests. You may send your personalised final PDF to a print shop for that event. Do not sell, share or redistribute the blank template, source files or editable layouts. No commercial/template-resale licence is included.

Message Pinogri on Etsy for download support.
